label: UHPLC-Q-Exactive Orbitrap MS-based brain-gut metabolomics implicates multi-pathway modulation by Ginseng stem-leaf saponins in chronic fatigue syndrome mice.
summary: Ginseng stem-leaf saponins (GSLS) were evaluated as potential bioactive food ingredients by characterizing brain-gut metabolic disturbances in a chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS) mouse model and assessing the regulatory effects of GSLS using ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography-Q-Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometry (UHPLC-Q-Exactive Orbitrap MS).
